name: Tabs
description: Sections of a card, one shown at a time; each Tab carries its label and its panel.

label.description: Names the tab list for a screen reader; it is not drawn.

variant.description: primary is a segmented pill on a track; secondary a line under the chosen tab.

defaultSelectedKey.description: Starts on this tab's id; the merchant changes it. The first tab when unset.

selectedKey.description: Pinned: shows exactly this tab until the next tree.
